{{Top}}
{{Citation}}
{{Quote|That's no moon. It's a space station.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], scrutinizing the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>|audio=ThatsNoMoon-ANH.flac}}
[[File:Moons_of_Tatooine.jpg|thumb|right|350px|The moons of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]]]
A '''moon''' was defined as a naturally occurring object that orbited a celestial body, such as a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] or other body larger than itself. Moons could vary in size, [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] conditions, climate, indigenous life, and other such categories. Some moons were barren rocks that existed in the vacuum of [[Realspace/Legends|space]], such as [[Folor]], in orbit around [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]], while others could be covered in lush, dense jungle, such as [[Yavin 4/Legends|the fourth moon]] of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]]. The number of moons a planet had could also vary greatly.

In some cases, moons were called '''worlds'''<ref name="DB Yavin">{{DB|location|yavin4|Yavin 4}}</ref> if they were developed and/or populated enough. Densely populated [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], known as the Smugglers' Moon, orbited [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and was covered in sprawling cityscape, not unlike the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] world [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]] was considered a moon for a period of time because it masqueraded as one of 18 moons orbiting the gas giant [[Mobus/Legends|Mobus]]. However, its status as a moon could vary due to its mobile nature, amongst other unique traits. [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]] orbited very closely around its parent planet, [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], to the point that during certain times of the year, they shared atmosphere, leading some to consider them to be like sister planets.

Some planets, such as [[Carida/Legends|Carida]], used their moon as a mascot. Carida's [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] had its emblem carved upon the surface of Carida's moon. However, during [[Mako Spince]]'s schooling at the academy, Spince used [[antimatter]] to attempt to remove the emblem. The moon was destroyed, instead, leading to Spince's expulsion from the academy.<ref name="Hutt Gambit">''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref>

[[Superweapon/Legends|Superweapons]], some producing effects similar to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] in the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]], were sometimes used on moons, but to the same devastating effect. During the start of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]], an inhabited world in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], was rendered uninhabitable by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] through the use of a powerful [[dovin basal]] pulling the moon [[Dobido]] towards and eventually impacting the surface, rendering the planet unsuitable to continue supporting life, in a technique known as [[Yo'gand's Core]]. Later in the same war, after the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]], the Yuuzhan Vong attempted to recreate their lost homeworld of [[Yuuzhan'tar]] on Coruscant and used powerful dovin basals to move three of its smaller moons around while the largest was destroyed and the resulting rubble and debris was used to form the [[Rings of Coruscant|Rainbow Bridge]].

{{Moon-stub}}
